title: Geologic Map of the Sandridge Quadrangle, Berkeley, Dorchester, and Orangeburg Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2010, Geologic Map of the Sandridge Quadrangle, Berkeley, Dorchester, and Orangeburg Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-175, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR'd map sheet; map face is OCR noise. OCR misreads: 'Thickness | to 40 feet' and 'Thickness | to 7 feet' read as 1 (inferred); '@Pwds' read as QPwds; 'Qfi' read as Qfl; 'clayey quartz and' read as clayey quartz sand. Toney Bay Member description begins 'The Waccamaw formation is', kept as printed. Uppermost elevations (75, 95, 135 ft) recorded as unit tops with no datum printed. Section A-A' read from page-image tiles (crop of the section strip at 144 dpi): holes 38-260, 38-261, 38-265, 38-262, 38-250, 38-245, 8-342, 8-67, 8-341 with land-surface and contact elevations read off the section's own feet scale (inferred, about +/-1 ft); 38-244 is drawn but its top sits above the drawn valley floor and was left out. Distances along the section not read. No datum printed for the section. Contact and drill hole symbol from the legend only. SUBSURFACE: none beyond the recorded values.
